comments: 0af63767: ;Call the FileMan utility to edit the data
f5c1f859: ;Initialize variables for the FileMan utility
024b1560: ;If there's a DT node, extract the date/time stamp and save it
efac679b: ;Clean up variables
d8943e7a: ;Write the field label on the screen
31910720: ;Exit the field write subroutine
5a26ce3e: ;Write the field value on the screen
59e5a87a: ;If the field value is too long, call the word-wrapping utility
901e5977: ;If the field is read-only and has word-processing syntax, display a message
ad9a7ede: ;Read the user's response, handle timeouts and up-arrow exits
8458603b: Exit routine
098f7ac2: Increment DQ, which is a stack counter for the DIE routines
2b568d83: Branch to the routine/label specified by DQ
6c6d9c75: If the DE array for this DQ is defined, go to the PR label to process a returned value. Otherwise, write out the prompt and do the transform logic.

50ece665: If X is null, branch based on the value of DV. DV is the validation string for the field being edited. The different branches are: go to A if DV doesn't contain 'R' (required); exit if DV contains 'R' (required field); exit if date field D is less than or equal to 0; go to A for all other cases.
b725acd7: If X starts with '?', go to the QS label which displays help. If X starts with '^', call the D routine to do additional validation, then exit to ^DIE17.
47a98791: If X is '@', call the D routine to do additional validation, then branch to Z^DIE2 which edits another field.

8f4e3cc5: If X is a space, DV contains 'd' (date field), and the DV doesn't contain 'P' (no pattern match), and the user has a default value defined in ^DISV, set X to that default value. If DV doesn't contain 'D' or 'S', write out the default value.

8fedeaf6: Branch to various labels/routines based on DV. If DV is null, go to M^DIE17. If DV contains 'V', go to ^DIE3. If DV doesn't contain 'S', go to P (presumably to do post-processing). If a computed MUMPS expression is defined for the field (node 12.1 in DD), execute it. Set % to the external value to display by parsing DU (M code holding field attributes). If % is non-null and DIC('S') is defined, execute it (screening logic). If no errors, write out the external value unless DB(DQ) is defined (indicates an error state).
d92ff92e: ;Check next piece for key, quit if nothing left
df325bae: ;If no matches were found, write remainder and set X to value segment
8adc089d: ;If 'P'ickable, set DIC and flags, call Lookup, quit if failed
bdb00b98: ;If not Numeric type, preserve any Decimal, quit if invalid data
68467d27: ;Strip redundant leading 0's from $P'iece, strip redundant trailing 0's
03d1ecdf: ;Preserves contents of the variable Y and suppresses some MUMPS interaction by killing the naked indicator YS.
3328f043: ;Creates an audit trail entry in the ^DISV global for a field that has been edited. Stores the new value in the DG array and branches to the 'A' label if the field is a date/time field.
2f57a5f9: ;Generates an audible error signal and branches to an error handling routine if the data in the DB array for the current question is defined.
dcb0c8dd: ;Sets X to a non-numeric value ('?BAD') for testing purposes.
923d2638: ;The main entry point. Initializes DZ, calls D and QQ^DIEQ routines, then goes to label B.
3e8151d9: ;The D helper routine. Sets D to the current field number (DIFLD), and populates DQ() array with field properties (label, value, input transform) for the current field.

7fb95420: ;The Y helper routine. Performs various checks and operations based on the value of X and other conditions related to field properties (DE(), DV). If X is '@', it sets X to the value of Y, otherwise it goes to labels RD, A, or N depending on the conditions.
a54d7acc: Executes code stored in the 2nd node of the DQ cross-reference if present.
e07d44ac: If DG contains 'P' and the referenced file exists, sets X to the primary file number and Y to the primary file #.01 field value. If the entry in the referenced file does not exist, quits.

4f7514cf: If DG contains 'V' and Y is a valid entry reference, sets X to the primary file number and Y to the #.01 field value of the entry. If the .01 field of the primary file has a transform, also sets DG and re-executes.
824c3673: If DG contains 'D', executes the fileman data dictionary utility code. If DG contains 'S', extracts a piece of the X input string delimited by ';' based on the Y input string, stores in Y.
8c883afe: ;If variable is undefined or if variable is defined as an 'X' (exit) command, quit.
f3e5c520: ;If the validator only has 'I' or '#', branch to Reed code.
d767167f: ;If the variable is defined, branch to Reed code. Otherwise, branch to Prompt mode.
b1134d20: ;Quit if neither of the above conditions are met.
dd432c43: ;Set the name of the current routine and set the question number to 1.
c7f8f7e7: ;Set the attributes for the field being edited: data type, validator, user lookup prefix, field label, and field number.
fcc97a66: ;Set the user lookup prefix for the field.
2e434149: ;Branch to Reed code.
0a2192ec: ;Quit.

d8085018: ;If the group revision is greater than 9, execute the DIE17 Filer utility. Set the delimiter to 'U'. If the variable is undefined or set to 'U', branch to the 'A' label. Otherwise, set the variable as the new value, set the DIC(0) variable to 'F', set the DW variable to the current question number, and branch to the DIE17 Output transformer.
a44902e3: ;If the input X is empty, set the 7th piece of the subfile record to empty, set DGJTST to 'SIGNED', and set Y to the string '@2'
7ff42b69: ;Quit

fed867ec: ;If DG is defined, call the F^DIE17 routine, set Y to the up-arrow character, set DQ to 3, call the X3 routine, go to label A if Y is undefined or if Y is the up-arrow, set X to Y, set DIC(0) to 'F', set DW to DQ, and call the OUT^DIE17 routine
f9e00fc9: Set the value of DGJTST to 'REVIEWED' for the MUMPS cross reference X3
46b2a847: Quit the MUMPS routine

b31335da: If the value of DG is defined and greater than 9, perform the following actions: Call the MUMPS routine F^DIE17, then call DE, set Y to the up-arrow character, set DQ to 5, call X5, go to label A if Y is not defined or if Y is the up-arrow character, set X to Y, set DIC(0) to 'F', set DW to the value of DQ, and then go to the OUT^DIE17 label
5d97ca34: Set the value of DGJTST to the value of the 'DT' node in file 393 for the current entry (D0)
941b0c0c: Quit the MUMPS routine

af122655: If the value of DG is defined and greater than 9, perform the following actions: Call the MUMPS routine F^DIE17, then call DE, set Y to the up-arrow character, set DQ to 6, call X6, go to label A if Y is not defined or if Y is the up-arrow character, set X to Y, set DIC(0) to 'F', set DW to the value of DQ, and then go to the OUT^DIE17 label
243a52d3: If the first piece of DGJTST (delimited by '^') is null or empty, set DGJTST to 'INCOMPLETE' and set Y to '@8'
52d54dff: Quit the MUMPS routine

f6065f93: If the value of DG is defined and greater than 9, perform the following actions: Call the MUMPS routine F^DIE17, then call DE, set Y to the up-arrow character, set DQ to 7, call X7, go to label A if Y is not defined or if Y is the up-arrow character, set X to Y, set DIC(0) to 'F', set DW to the value of DQ, and then go to the OUT^DIE17 label
10df5120: If the third piece of DGJTST is empty, set DGJTST to 'DICTATED' and Y to '@8'
0e115a38: Quit the current execution path

7fcc3e6f: If DG is defined and greater than 9, execute F^DIE17, set Y to U (undefined), set DQ to 8, execute X8, go to label A if Y is undefined or if Y is equal to U, set X to Y, set DIC(0) to 'F', set DW to DQ, and go to OUT^DIE17
34eff55c: If the fifth piece of DGJTST is empty, set DGJTST to 'TRANSCRIBED' and Y to '@8'
e8e93025: Quit the current execution path

8fc7cc71: If DG is defined and greater than 9, execute F^DIE17, set Y to U (undefined), set DQ to 9, execute X9, go to label A if Y is undefined or if Y is equal to U, set X to Y, set DIC(0) to 'F', set DW to DQ, and go to OUT^DIE17
66f45682: If the 7th piece of DGJTST is empty, set DGJTST to 'SIGNED' and Y to '@8'
eb0c5998: Quit the routine

cf39c174: Call the FileMan DIE17 routine to update the file. If the variable Y is undefined or equal to the code for up-arrow (U), quit and go to the label A. Otherwise, set X to Y, set DIC(0) to 'F' (indicating a FileMan lookup), set DW to DQ, and transfer control to the label OUT^DIE17.
6e0fb455: Set status to 'SIGNED NO REVIEW' if the third piece of DGJTDEL is 0.
d4ec6fb6: Exit the code block.

Otherwise, set X to Y and go to the OUT^DIE17 routine.
4ab06c71: Set status to 'REVIEWED' if the third piece of DGJTDEL is 1.
